text:
Priya (Partnerships): Hey team — quick sync on EdgeBox SI integration + marketplace packaging. We have a target launch week (T-3) for the joint listing, need signoff on licensing addendum and the SI co-marketing plan.
Diego (SW Eng): thanks — from runtime side EdgeBox quantized weights look good (int8). API backwards compatible. main asks: simple model alias (edgebox-v1) and a fallback to hosted-rw-small if local fails.
Alex (Solutions): For SI installs we should include an integration guide + sample deploy script. suggestion: one-click marketplace install that wires credentials to the SI project.
Ken (Product): Agreed. Also need to decide bundle SKUs: marketplace-hosted, marketplace-dl (weights download for on-prem), and SI-managed (installation service). pricing needed by Friday.
Leah (Legal): On licensing: provider gave us a permissive license but with export carveouts and a non-resale clause. We need a short addendum for marketplace customers clarifying redistribution boundaries and SI reseller rights. I'll draft language today.
Priya (Partnerships): Leah — can you confirm whether the non-resale clause blocks us from offering the download SKU to reseller SIs?
Leah (Legal): It restricts sublicensing. SI-managed installs are fine if the SI is delivering professional services (no re-distribution of model weights). The download SKU is allowed only to end-customers who sign the addendum. We'll add a checkbox in the marketplace flow.
Diego (SW Eng): technical note: downloaded weights will be packaged with a small runtime shim (sha256 checksum and model.json). we should embed license hash in model.json so SI installations validate acceptance. sample snippet:```json
{"name":"edgebox-v1","license_hash":"sha256:...","quant":"int8"}```
Alex (Solutions): +1. Also include a checklist for air-gapped installs: signed tarball, offline verification steps, and KMS instructions.
Priya (Partnerships): Marketing/announce cadence: partner wants a joint blog + marketplace spotlight day 0. We should gate public announce until export clearance and legal signoff, but do a soft SI partner announcement earlier.
Ken (Product): We need a canonical support matrix in the listing: supported EdgeBox firmware versions, GPU/TPU options, expected latency numbers (p50/p95) and recommended batch sizes. Diego can we get those numbers today?
Diego (SW Eng): I'll run perf sweep on int8 vs fp16 across seq len 128/512. will post numbers in this thread by EOD.
Leah (Legal): Draft addendum uploaded: https://redwood-internal/docs/partner-addenda/edgebox-addendum-draft.md — pls review. Key points: non-resale enforcement, geo-restrictions (EU export controls), and audit rights clause for enterprise installs.
Priya (Partnerships): CI — can we stage the bundle artifacts to the marketplace staging bucket?
ci-bot: Artifact uploaded to s3://marketplace-staging/edgebox/edgebox-v1-20260321.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...)
